notes.title: We are happy to announce the grand opening of our official Steam page!
notes.content:
So first of all, wow, seeing your game on Steam is really something else man... It is as it made all of our hard work "real"! :D
Getting all emotional up in here. just watching it.. pfff....
We are UglyCake games - Yaron Granot (Art) and Ori Brusilovsky (Code) and we made Volcano Tower in our free time, in countless sleepless nights and in an infinite amount of work for only 2 determined guys!
After 3 and some years we are proud to announce that [b]Volcano Tower will be available for all mobile devices FOR-FREE TOMORROW[/b], so be sure to check your iOS\Android appstore for Volcano Tower, as we are working on bringing you the Steam version.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32750975/1481f2e331b2421f3ca3669333ad2d57f4d19986.png[/img]

💀 What is Volcano Tower?
Volcano Tower is an endless-platformer for Android, iOS and Steam, filled with clutch moments, fast-paced action and hard difficulty challenges.
Avoid being smashed, burned or otherwise eliminated by obstacles falling from above as the volcano tower crumbles around you!
How far can YOU go?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32750975/b674fdf51da204f3351231de1e57196031fe1b6b.jpg[/img]

Be sure to follow us for updates and future indie developments ːsteamhappyː
